title: Physics-Audited Agentic Discovery in Scientific Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.07379v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic discovery can yield mechanics surrogates with low validation error that nonetheless violate physical requirements. We present Physics-Audited Agentic SciML (PA-SciML), a framework combining large language model agents with physics auditing. Physical requirements, encoded as contracts such as superposition, boundary conditions, and causality, are fixed before candidate search and tested on predicted fields without reference solutions, including through an adversarial search. Audit results guide later proposals and model selection but are reported separately from validation error. Single-edit tests document reusable design changes. Four solid-mechanics problems of increasing complexity, from parametric elasticity to heterogeneous stiffness fields and cyclic plasticity with combined hardening, reveal causality, zero-input, and stress-bound violations in surrogates selected by error alone. translated_title: 科学机器学习中的物理审计式智能体发现
translated_abstract: 智能体式发现能够产生验证误差很低的力学代理模型，然而这些模型仍可能违反物理要求。我们提出了物理审计式智能体科学机器学习（PA-SciML），这是一个将大语言模型智能体与物理审计相结合的框架。物理要求被编码为契约形式，例如叠加原理、边界条件和因果性，在候选模型搜索之前即已固定，并在预测场上进行测试而无需参考解，其中包括通过对抗性搜索进行测试。审计结果会指导后续的提案和模型选择，但与验证误差分开报告。单一编辑测试记录了可复用的设计修改。四个复杂度递增的固体力学问题——从参数化弹性到非均匀刚度场，再到带组合硬化的循环塑性——揭示了仅凭误差选择出的代理模型中存在的因果性、零输入和应力界限违反问题。在弹性动力学中，两个代理模型……
tldr: 本文提出PA-SciML框架，将大语言模型智能体与预定义的物理契约审计相结合，无需参考解即可发现仅凭误差筛选出的力学代理模型所违反的因果性、零输入和应力界限等物理要求。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PA-SciML, a framework combining LLM agents with physics-contract auditing that detects causality, zero-input, and stress-bound violations in error-selected mechanics surrogates without requiring reference solutions.
